name: stale-card-indicator
title: stale card indicator
description:
This app monitors how long issues stay in selected columns on a project board. When a task exceeds the configured interval, a colored dot (stale level) appears on the ticket and escalates over time.
The stale level is a custom field and should be placed among the first fields on the issue to be visible on the board. This helps teams quickly spot overdue issues and bottlenecks.
Weekend days are excluded, and holiday data can be configured through a widget. This ensures the stale level reflects only actual working days for more accurate issue aging.

widgets.name: stale card indicator: Manage holidays
widgets.description: Allows to fetch public holidays by country and county using the Nager.Date API. Retrieved holidays are displayed within the app and can be deleted at any time. All imported holidays are automatically considered in stale level calculation, ensuring that non-working days are excluded when determining whether a task exceeds the configured time.
